items.title: Wildflower Stem DXF Design for Botanical Garden Screens

items.title: Overlapping Scale Mesh DXF Screen for Textured Facades
items.description: Small curved scale shapes overlap diagonally in a dense woven mesh, similar to fish scales or roof tiles. The fine, repetitive texture suits building facades, fence infill panels, and screens needing subtle depth.
